title: Render validated Task Outcome as human-readable Markdown
rawUserRequest: Implement the derived Task Outcome Markdown renderer from the execution plan. Render all required sections, preserve empty sections as None, keep language-neutral English keys/structure, avoid scores and unsupported claims, and never alter machine JSON or raw evidence. Execute this Work Item serially through its own PR and lifecycle closure.
